name: Magiworks
detailed_description:
Rebuild the Magic. Rewrite Time.

In the shattered remains of the Chrono-Circle, magic is fading from the world. As the last living Spellwright, your task is clear: Reignite the Arcane Forge. Automate the forgotten spellwork. Unravel time itself.

Deep below the ruins lies the Magiworks, a massive tower of ancient machinery that once powered the ley lines of the world. You’ll start by manually channeling raw mana, then automate your growing spell empire with conduits, scroll writers, and relic amplifiers. Master the art of arcane automation and restore the flow of magic before it's lost forever.

Key Features

  • Master Arcane Automation: Progress from simple manual spellcasting to designing vast, complex networks of mystical infrastructure. Unlock conduits, rune engines, and scroll presses to produce spells passively and grow your power exponentially.

  • Discover Ancient Relics: Unearth dozens of powerful relics that permanently alter the way you play. A single relic can change your entire strategy, offering unique bonuses and game-changing rules that persist across timelines.

  • Collapse Time: Perform a "Timeline Collapse," the ultimate prestige system. Reset your progress to earn Chrono Knowledge, unlocking deeper secrets, permanent upgrades, and new paths to power that accelerate your journey.

  • Deep Lore, Light Touch: Uncover a rich narrative woven through ancient ruins and the descriptions of forgotten spells and relics. Hints of forgotten empires and spellwright rivalries await those who look closely.

  • A Constantly Evolving World: Never play the same game twice! New spells, relics, and global events are generated and introduced every week, ensuring the challenge is always fresh and there is always something new to craft.

  • Seamless Cross-Platform Play: Start your game on your PC and continue on the go. Your progress is synced between the Steam, Web, and Mobile versions of the game.

[quote=A Living Game]

With regular updates that deliver fresh content, Magiworks is a game that evolves constantly. We are dedicated to providing an experience that always has something new for both new and veteran players to discover, master, and automate. Join our Discord to become part of the development journey!

[/quote]

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (21H1 or Newer)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual-Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 Capable GPU (Integrated Graphics Supported)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Quad-Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics Card with 1GB+ VRAM (Integrated Graphics Supported)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device

linux_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual-Core Processor

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard audio device
